info.cls_name: 世界格局與歷史地理視野
info.cls_ename: World platforms and perspectives of history & geography

description.describe_ch: 「越南地理人文」這門課讓學生可探索越南國家跟文化，了解越南如何從殖民時期演變至今，若對越南的國家人民有一定了解後，越南的地理人文知識是非常精彩的；這門課程不止提供相關背景知識如越南地理、文化，也能從各個不同觀點如經濟、宗教、著名景點對越南歷史有深入了解。學生可以在東南亞國家的業務中建立良好的人際關係。
description.describe_eh: "Vietnam Geography, People and Culture" is an exploration of Vietnam country and culture as it developed from pre-colonial times until the present. The knowledge of Vietnam geography, people and culture is so vital in demand of understanding Vietnam country and people. The subject not only supplies the background knowledge such as Vietnam geography, Vietnamese Cultural Profile, but also provides the knowledge of Vietnam history and culture in the different viewpoints: Vietnam's economy in ASEAN, Vietnam religions, some famous venue such as Hanoi capital, Hue, Ho Chi Minh city. Finally, the course will be able to contribute to a greater understanding and cooperation between Vietnamese people and people from all over the world. The student can establish good interpersonal relationships in the business of Southeast Asia countries.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol: 手機靜音，僅限課堂用途。課堂期間不得使用社交媒體。保持課堂專注，不得閒聊。保持教室整潔，勿亂丟垃圾。禁止在課堂吃食物。請勿在課堂打瞌睡。遵守考試規定，不得相互交流答案。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
This course is physical class, request all students need to show up.
Attending class and working team will be counted for 30%.
Midterm Exam counted 40% and final exam counted for 40%. Both mid-term and final exam are Oral presentation.
The class will be divided into small group and need to finish the mission together.
This course will be taught in english, all presentations need to me show in english version.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
提交的所有學術作業和報告必須是原創的，引用他人資料必須正確標註來源。
鼓勵學術討論，但要保持獨立思考和尊重不同觀點。
在合作研究中，需明確說明各自貢獻，並尊重共同作者。
在考試中，不得幫助他人作弊或接受他人幫助。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: All submitted academic assignments and reports must be original, and citations of others' materials must be properly attributed. Academic discussion is encouraged, but independent thinking and respect for different viewpoints must be maintained. In collaborative research, each person's contribution must be clearly stated, and co-authors must be respected. During examinations, assisting others in cheating or accepting assistance from others is strictly prohibited.

courseBankC.core_item: 知識探索：能培養多元領域學習的興趣；能統整跨領域的知識；能持續從事跨領域的學習。
courseBankC.core_eng: Knowledge Pursuit：To integrate extensive interests, curiosities and literacy of multidisciplinary knowledge and internalize one’s won viewpoints.

courseBankC.describe_en: Planning by themselves for their exchange program, internship program, or even investment in Vietnam
courseBankC.core_item: 公民實踐：能關注社會問題；能重視人與環境之和諧；能參與公民社會活動。
courseBankC.core_eng: Global Citizenship：To be equipped with humanistic sentiments toward the care of social and natural environment; conduct life-long learning, civic responsibility and serve the public .
